name: Tensile test pmdao-tto-tt-S355-2 on test piece Zx2
description: Tensile test at room temperature (20 degC) according to DIN EN ISO 6892-1, extensometer removed after 3.9 % strain, no increase of test speed. Performed at BAM, Berlin, project PMDao-onto_1.
source: Real data: test piece Zx2 (process pmdao-tto-tt-S355-2) of 'Full dataset of several mechanical tests on an S355 steel sheet as reference data for digital representations', Bundesanstalt fuer Materialforschung und -pruefung (BAM), Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6778336, CC-BY-4.0 (also mapped to PMDco in https://github.com/materialdigital/tensile-test-ontology). Classes and relations from PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2, CC-BY-4.0, Plattform MaterialDigital, https://w3id.org/pmd/co
